product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)
contract: a topic is either a `say` - a sentence written in this registry about this bundle's own policy, with the record it comes from named in `cites` - or a `read` - a binding naming the page-data path the answer must be read from at view time. No `read` answer is copied into this registry, so the record it quotes stays the one truth for that fact.

honesty.status: an advisor is a scripted guide, not an instructor and not an AI: no model runs behind one, nothing is generated at view time, no network is reached, and every line an advisor can say is written in this registry or read from another registry in this bundle.
honesty.not_advice: nothing an advisor says is a certification, a permit, a code ruling or a substitute for the qualified person on site; where an advisor states a duty it states it as this Academy teaches it, not as any jurisdiction's law.
honesty.not_scored: talking to an advisor changes no score and unlocks nothing: no grader reads advisor state, and the suite asserts it by reading the graders.
honesty.not_a_person: an advisor represents no real worker, steward, instructor or union officer, and no real union local is named: the figures are the Academy's own schematic avatars wearing the Academy's own crew marks.
honesty.closed_book: an advisor cannot be asked an open question because it has no way to answer one. The topics below are all of them, and the suite counts them.

bindings.conditions.ppe: the PPE list on this room's condition record
bindings.conditions.hazards: the hazards this room's condition record carries
bindings.conditions.env: the lux, air changes and noise this room is held to
bindings.surface.finish: the floor finish this room is given, and why
bindings.crib.tools: the tools this district's crib issues
bindings.crib.drill: how the crib check is scored
bindings.sim.walkaround: the pre-shift walkaround points for this hall's seat
bindings.sim.rubric: what the seat at this hall actually measures
bindings.hall.rooms: the rooms this hall is laid out with
bindings.campus.network: the other campuses and the distance to them
bindings.city.anchors: the recorded places around this campus
bindings.city.walk: which recorded places fall inside a ten- and fifteen-minute walk of this campus

guide.name: Orientation guide
guide.role: meets you at the door and says what the place is
guide.greeting: First time in this hall? Ask me what it is and where to start.

topics.ask: What is laid out in here?

topics.say: At the induction room, every time. Find the safety steward, get what the room is held to, then walk the practice bays. Nothing here is locked, so the order is yours - but that is the order a shift starts in.

topics.ask: How much of this is real?
topics.say: Three words are used on every label and they mean exactly what they say. RECORDED is a fact taken from a cited source and checked against it. DERIVED is computed from a recorded fact. SCHEMATIC is drawn to teach and is not a survey of anywhere. The buildings you are standing in are SCHEMATIC. The coordinates the campus sits on are RECORDED.

safety-steward.name: Safety steward
safety-steward.role: holds the room to its own condition record
safety-steward.greeting: Before you go past me: ask what this room is held to.

topics.ask: What do I need on in here?

topics.say: Yes, and the Academy teaches it as a duty rather than a right: if the condition in front of you is not the condition the work was planned for, you stop and you say so. Practising the refusal is the point of the induction room. On a real site the law that backs you is your jurisdiction's, not this bundle's.

crib-keeper.name: Crib keeper
crib-keeper.role: issues, calibrates and takes back the tools
crib-keeper.greeting: Issue, calibration, return. Ask me what this crib holds.

topics.ask: What is issued out of this crib?
How is the crib check scored?

topics.say: Nobody's. This is a schematic aid for tool identification and crib discipline - not an inventory of any real toolroom, not tool competency certification, and no manufacturer or brand is named or drawn anywhere in it.

layout-hand.name: Layout hand
layout-hand.role: sets out the work and defends the control points
layout-hand.greeting: Everything downstream is wrong if the line is wrong.

topics.say: A mark everything else is measured from, put in once and protected. Measure from the control point, never from the last thing you set - that is how a small error becomes a cumulative one, and it is the habit this floor exists to build.

topics.ask: How do I know the line is true?
topics.say: Close it. Run the measurement back to where it started and see whether it lands on the same mark. A line you have not closed is a line you are hoping about.

inspector.name: Inspector
inspector.role: holds the work to the acceptance criteria
inspector.greeting: I sign what meets the criterion. Ask me what it is.

topics.ask: What does the seat here measure?
Can I talk my way to a pass?
topics.say: No. Every rubric axis is computed from measured state, and nothing narrative can change a score. Neither can what you are wearing, which ape you picked, or how long you spoke to me.

topics.ask: Does a pass here certify me?
topics.say: It does not. These are schematic physics for practising control discipline. No seat time here counts toward equipment certification, and the assessment gates still demand unaided verification runs.

foreman.name: Foreman
foreman.role: runs the shift brief and the hand-offs
foreman.greeting: Shift starts here. Ask me what gets walked before it does.

topics.ask: What gets walked before a start?

topics.say: No - it is a habit-builder. No seat is locked behind it, completing it changes no score, and it is not an equipment inspection record. Do it anyway. The habit is the only part of it that travels to a real yard.

Say what changed, what is still open, and what you would do next if you were staying. Three sentences. A hand-off that only says what was finished hands the next crew your assumptions as well as your work.

records-clerk.name: Records clerk
records-clerk.role: keeps the permits, the certificates and the as-builts
records-clerk.greeting: If it is not written down it did not happen. Ask me where it is written.

topics.say: Into this browser and nowhere else. Nothing you do here is uploaded, and no account exists to upload it to. Clear the site data and the record is gone - which is the trade-off for it never having left.

Nothing, by itself. It teaches and it records what you practised. Certification is issued by the body with the standing to issue it, under your jurisdiction - and no partnership with any such body is claimed anywhere in this bundle.

Proposed ones. Every district named in the schools pack is recorded as a proposed partner - no district has reviewed or agreed to any of it, and the registry says so on every entry rather than in a footnote.

dispatcher.name: Dispatcher
dispatcher.role: sends you to the right campus and the right hall
dispatcher.greeting: Tell me the trade and I will tell you the campus.

topics.ask: What can I reach on foot?

topics.say: The coordinates are RECORDED and the distances between campuses are DERIVED from them by great circle. The campus itself is SCHEMATIC: no ground has been acquired, no building has been consented, and nothing here is a site plan.
